_doc: VOLTA Studio project + preset registry. The server runs ONLY the argv arrays defined here (no shell, no client strings).
argv elements: a literal string, or {"each":"<arg>","flag":"-i"} (repeat flag+value for a files arg).

Placeholders inside a string: {argName} (validated user arg), {out} (allocated output path), {projectDir}. A string that is exactly {argName} for an enum whose value is an array expands to several argv elements.
Executables: ffmpeg, node, npx, npm, python3, bash (resolved on a fixed PATH) or ./node_modules/.bin/<tool> inside the project.

output: {"ext":"mp4"} allocates {out}. Default folder is /Volumes/Windsor/VOLTA/studio/renders/<projectId>/ (needs >= 3 GiB free); set output.dir (absolute, ~ ok, or relative to the project) to write elsewhere.
outputDirs: folders scanned for recent outputs (relative to the project, or absolute). The Windsor renders folder for the project is always scanned too.
progress: remotion | ffmpeg | generic. durationFrom (ffmpeg): {"arg":"duration"} | {"sum":"<files arg>"} | {"file":"<file arg>"}.

projects.name: Hermes Video Pipeline
projects.notes: Brief to vertical social clip pipeline (README.md). 55 mp4s live under production/. node orchestrator.js runs the full demo pipeline; render workers are the Remotion and HyperFrames projects it feeds.

presets.label: Run orchestrator demo
presets.description: node orchestrator.js: runs the whole brief-to-output pipeline and writes outputs/demo_<timestamp>/.
presets.confirm: Runs the full Hermes demo pipeline (agents may call external APIs) and writes a new outputs/demo_* folder. Continue?

projects.name: OpenMontage Composer

presets.label: Render composition

presets.description: remotion render src/remotion/index.ts <composition> to the Windsor renders folder (2 workers).

projects.name: Remotion Animation Workflow
projects.notes: Skills, spec templates and a starter scaffold (no package.json or entry yet), so there is nothing to render here. Copy starter/ into a new project, then add it to config/studio-projects.json.

projects.name: TikTok Four Files
projects.notes: Plan and narration only (posts Thu Oct 29, 8 PM ET). No render tooling; use the ffmpeg tools to cut and mux the finished clips.

projects.name: TikTok Warm Grain Grid

presets.label: Lint composition
presets.description: npx hyperframes lint: static composition checks (no render).

presets.label: Render project
presets.description: npx hyperframes render to the Windsor renders folder. Heavy: spawns Chrome workers.
presets.confirm: HyperFrames renders spawn headless Chrome and use several GB of RAM. Start the render?

projects.name: Universal Consciousness P1
projects.notes: Still-image + narration slideshow built with ffmpeg shell scripts (hyperframes.json here is metadata only, there is no HyperFrames composition). Scripts write to output/.

presets.label: render.sh (full cut)
presets.description: bash render.sh: renders 7 beats from assets/*.png + *.mp3 and concatenates output/universal-consciousness-p1-final.mp4.
presets.confirm: Re-encodes 7 beats with ffmpeg and overwrites output/universal-consciousness-p1-final.mp4. Continue?

presets.label: render_tiktok_v2.sh
presets.confirm: Runs render_tiktok_v2.sh, which rewrites files in output/. Continue?

projects.name: ffmpeg Tools
projects.notes: Cut, join, reframe and mux. Inputs are picked from any project's outputs or the Generations manifest by file id; the server builds the argv. Outputs land in the Windsor renders folder.

presets.label: Trim
presets.description: Cut a section out of a video (re-encoded, frame-accurate).

presets.label: Concat
presets.description: Join 2 to 12 videos in order. Everything is scaled and padded to the first clip's frame size at 30 fps.

presets.label: Make vertical 9:16
presets.description: Reframe to 1080x1920: blurred-background fit (keeps the whole frame) or centre crop.

presets.label: Mux audio
presets.description: Replace a video's soundtrack with an audio file (video stream copied, audio AAC, stops at the shorter one). Pick the audio from outputs or Generations voice items.
